title: ZenXveda: Reimagined Shaders
author: ZenXveda Official
description: 水面表現、雲、自然な色味を調整するVanilla+系シェーダー。
fullDescription: 📦 ZenXveda Reimagined Shaders — v2.0.2 Release Welcome to v2.0.2 of ZenXveda Reimagined Shaders for Minecraft Bedrock Edition! This maintenance release synchronizes our CurseForge release channel with the latest Minecraft Bedrock updates, ensuring smooth client-side auto-updates, rock-solid resource pack validation, and full stability for the Deferred Technical Preview pipeline. 🔄 What's Changed in v2.0.2 📦 Pack Manifest Version Alignment Incremented Internal Version : Updated manifest.json header and modules to v2.0.2 ( [2, 0, 2] ) for instant CurseForge client-side update detection and automatic resource reloading. 🌐 CurseForge Distribution Synchronization Clean Archive Build : Compiled as ZenXveda_Reimagined_Shaders_v2.0.2.mcpack . Cross-Platform POSIX Standard : Normalized using strict forward slashes ( / ) to ensure zero-warning imports across Windows 10/11 PC, Android (Vulkan/GLES), iOS, and Consoles. ✨ Core Visuals & Stability Intact Invisible Vanilla Clouds : Calibrated full-alpha cloud mask ( textures/environment/clouds.png ) blocks vanilla cloud block generation, keeping the sky 100% dedicated to deferred volumetric atmospheric scattering. Fluid PBR & Dynamic Caustics : Smooth water normal maps and absorption curves ( roughness: 10 , metalness: 32 ) with zero z-fighting or texture conflicts. Engine Compatibility : Verified for Minecraft Bedrock 1.20+ through 26.60+ . 📥 Installation Instructions Download ZenXveda_Reimagined_Shaders_v2.0.2.mcpack and open it to import into Minecraft Bedrock Edition. In World Settings or Global Resources , activate ZenXveda Reimagined Shaders at the top. (For Full PBR Visuals) : Go to Settings → Video and select Deferred Technical Preview under Graphics Mode!

fullDescription: Changes since v1.4.0 Move regular, splash, and lingering potions into or out of a brewing stand in batches. The fuel counter shows how many brews remain (e.g. 16/20). Lock empty crafter slots or unlock all locked slots. Unavailable actions show a gray key. In Creative, press the same delete button twice to clear your inventory or hotbar, or delete matching items. The buttons are disabled in Survival and hidden in Pocket Old. Hover for one second to see a Japanese or English button tip that follows your pointer. The default Pocket layout groups inventory actions around the hotbar. Fixed touch feedback for selected-item drops, dropping matching items from the Pocket crafter, and controller transfers that could leave an item on the cursor. v1.4.0からの変更点 醸造台で通常・スプラッシュ・残留ポーションをまとめて出し入れできます。燃料は残りの醸造回数で表示します（例：16/20）。 自動作業台で空き枠を一括ロックし、ロックした枠をまとめて解除できます。操作できない鍵は灰色で表示します。 クリエイティブで同じ削除ボタンを続けて2回押すと、インベントリ全体、ホットバー全体、または選択したアイテムを削除できます。サバイバルでは無効になり、Pocket Oldでは非表示になります。 ボタンにマウスを1秒合わせると、ポインターに追従する日英の操作説明が表示されます。標準のPocket配置では操作ボタンをホットバーの左右にまとめました。 タッチで選択ドロップを押したときの表示、Pocketの自動作業台からの選択ドロップ、コントローラーで選択移動したあとにアイテムがカーソルに残る問題を修正しました。 Minecraft Bedrock for Windows 26.60.05. The v1.5.0 package was checked against v1.4.50: only the manifest changed. No new in-game test was run for this metadata update.

title: Sunrays VISUALS

fullDescription: New in V2 Lighting: works on 1.21.120+ (v1 needed 1.26). The tilted, long morning and evening rays are kept. Nights are clean and blue, and lightning has a purple flash. Biomes: all 93, including the End outer islands. Vanilla sounds, Nether particles and music, and special grass colours are back. Water colours are natural again. Skies and colour: 39 skies, each tinted to its biome's ray colour; a big soft sun glow and coloured sunsets; colour grading and lighting per group (warm, green, cold, pale, caves, Nether, End). Water and fog: 6 water types with caustics; light rays underwater; rain fog in each biome's colour. Profiles: Low / Balanced / High subpacks. PBR and light: global PBR (light through leaves), soft shadows and coloured block light. Living-world script: dust glowing in the sun rays; sun sparkles on water; birds and fireflies; falling leaves and cherry petals; rainbows and bubbles. Identity: a new icon, a language file and a license.

Night and caves: brighter blue moonlight, and caves you can see in. Safer PBR: a global PBR setting (soft light through leaves) plus soft shadows and coloured block light. Sounds: the standard sound setup; seagulls at beaches; birds in the morning; crickets and owls at night. compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: Chests no longer forced into the christmas set Every non-copper chest now uses normal chest art instead of christmas art: single, double, trapped, double trapped, ender, and the chest / trapped chest / ender chest block faces. The dedicated holiday textures ( christmas.png , christmas_double.png ) also ship the normal art, so the game's December chest swap no longer flips chests back to presents for a few days a year. New subpack: Christmas Forever The old christmas chest art now lives in its own subpack, so it can be turned back on from the pack's subpack menu. Two entries ship: Normal Chests (default) and Christmas Forever . A single subpack entry would always be applied, which is why the normal one exists as an explicit choice rather than relying on "no subpack selected". Normal chest textures from Bare Bones 26.51 were saturated per texture to the mean saturation this pack's chest art already had at that path, so the restored chests sit in the same palette as the rest of the pack. No resampling, alpha preserved byte for byte, only saturation moves — hue and value are untouched. Five chest block faces have no Bare Bones sprite, so the matching face of the same material is used rather than inventing new pixels ( chest_bottom from chest_top , trapped side/top/bottom from the chest faces, ender bottom from the ender top). Fixes Pack name and manifest version are in sync again (the name still said 1.2.1 while the version was already 1.2.2). Chest block faces no longer mix festive front/side/top art with plain bottoms. General bug fixes and polish.

fullDescription: # OS CLIENT V1.1 Use **OS CLIENT V1.1** on its own, or add any of the three extensions in any mix. Extensions and info: https://oskullo-yt.github.io/OS-CLIENT/ ## Packs - **OS CLIENT V1.1**: the main client (HUD, keystrokes, hitbox, PvP utility, damage numbers and more). - **OS MINI-MAP V1.1**: chunk map, waypoints and waypoint beam, with all their settings. - **OS COSMETICS V1.1**: capes, wings, kitten, katana, halo, aura, bandana and particle trails, with all their settings. - **OS CHUNK BORDERS V1.1**: chunk border lines in 3rd person, with the colour setting. ## Install Put the extensions **above** OS CLIENT V1.1 in Global Resources. No loader is needed. Any mix works. ## New - Minimap, cosmetics and chunk borders are now optional packs. Their models, animations, render controllers and particles are no longer in the main pack. - Animated "get ... at" extensions link on the main menu. - New update card and changelog page on the start screen, with a full feature list. - PvP Utility and Elytra Indicator are now documented in the in-game feature list. - Pack description now points to the settings and the extensions site. ## Changed - Hitbox, damage indicator and PvP Utility only work on players within 15 blocks. - Hitbox is drawn on players only (no mob hitboxes). - Less work per player: hitbox colour and PvP Utility refresh less often. - Removed the big "OS CLIENT" text from the pack info panel. - Cleaner, smaller pack files and corrected manifests. ## Fixed - Armor error. - Removed the loading screen override. - Invalid JSON in the third-person nametag model. - Corrected the in-game hitbox description. ## Known issues - HUD elements shift while riding horses or boats. - The minimap does not remember your last waypoint after you rejoin a world. - The minimap can still add lag on low-end devices when it is turned on. fullDescription: 🎉 G-Flow Xray 1.3.1: Preset Combos! Some players only want one ore, and some don't want everything lit up at once. Now there's something in between. ✨ What's new ⛏️ Starter Ores Highlights Coal, Iron and Copper together. It's built for early-game mining, when you're gathering the basics for tools, armor and building. 💎 Rare Ores Highlights Diamond, Emerald and Ancient Debris together. It's built for deep mining and Nether trips, when you're hunting the valuable stuff. 🎚️ How to use it Open Settings → Global Resources → G-Flow Xray . Tap the pack's settings (gear) icon . Move the slider to Starter Ores or Rare Ores . Jump into your world and start mining. The new presets sit on the slider between the single ores and All Ores . 📌 Good to know Normal and deepslate versions of every ore in a preset are highlighted, so you don't miss anything at any depth. The single-ore options, the Nether ores and All Ores are all still there. It's still best with Vibrant Visuals , Smooth Lighting off, Brightness 100% and a higher Render Distance. 💬 Got an idea for another combo? Let me know which ores you'd like grouped together, and it might show up in a future update.

fullDescription: ZenXveda: Unbound Shaders — v1.0.0 Initial Release The Premier Cinematic PBR Shader Experience for Minecraft Bedrock Edition (1.20+ / 26.60+) Welcome to the official v1.0.0 Initial Release of ZenXveda: Unbound Shaders . Engineered from the ground up for Minecraft Bedrock, this release introduces cinematic lighting, volumetric cloudscapes, glowing ores, and photorealistic celestial bodies with high-performance 60+ FPS stability and 100% achievement compatibility. Release Highlights Photorealistic HD Round Sun Full Round Geometry : Replaced the vanilla pixelated square sun with a smooth, high-definition celestial solar sphere. Vibrant Visuals Dual-Pipeline : Native support for both standard Render Dragon ( sun.png ) and Bedrock Deferred Technical Preview ( sun_vv.png ), ensuring round rendering on every graphics mode. Rich Solar Details : Features a brilliant incandescent white core, multi-scale solar convective currents, warm golden plasma filaments, and a soft anti-aliased corona. Crystal-Clear HD Round Moon Full 8-Phase High-Resolution Map : Realistic lunar surface topography featuring crisp lunar maria (seas) and impact craters. Zero Blue Ring Artifacts : Tightly calibrated anti-aliased lunar rim with strictly zero stray alpha, completely eliminating the oversized blue halo bug caused by Bedrock's ACES tonemapper. Balanced Celestial Scale : Tuned disc radius for natural, elegant proportions in the night sky. Volumetric Skybox & Horizon Overhaul Volumetric Daytime Clouds : Realistic, multi-layered Unbound cloudscapes integrated with Bedrock's atmospheric light scattering. Seamless Horizon Transition : Applied smoothstep vertical feathering across the equatorial cubemap faces, eliminating harsh horizon seams and curved void bowl artifacts. Pure Dark Night Skies : Re-tuned ambient cubemap lighting curves to transition naturally from warm sunset twilight into a deep, star-filled night sky. Vanilla Cloud Occlusion : Fully occluded vanilla 2D block clouds to prevent visual clipping through custom volumetric clouds. Cinematic PBR Materials & Glowing Ores Sub-Surface Bioluminescent Ores : High-definition PBR emissive maps for Diamond, Gold, Iron, Redstone, Emerald, Lapis, Copper, and Nether Quartz ores. Crystal Dynamic Waters : Refractive water surfaces featuring realistic normal maps, sun/moon specular highlights, and gentle wave motion. Atmospheric Star Field : Immersive twinkling stars powered by custom vertex-lit star materials. Engine Optimization & Stability CurseForge & Bedrock 1.20+ Ready : Validated against strict Bedrock schema specifications ( min_engine_version: [1, 20, 0] ). 100% Clean Content Log : Fixed missing particle hooks, resolved particle schema definitions, and purged invalid material bindings. Zero Bloatware : Stripped redundant legacy files, duplicate update assets, and unused texture directories, achieving an ultra-compact package size (~26.9 MB). Strict JSON Compliance : All 85 internal JSON files verified with zero syntax errors, comments, or trailing commas. Compatibility & System Requirements Feature Specification Minecraft Edition Minecraft Bedrock Edition (Windows 10/11, Android, iOS, Xbox, PlayStation) Engine Version 1.20.0 through 26.60+ (Fully forward-compatible) Render Pipelines Standard Render Dragon & Deferred Technical Preview (Vibrant Visuals) Achievements 100% Safe (Does not disable Xbox / PSN achievements) Quick Installation Guide Download ZenXveda_Unbound_Shaders_v1.0.0.mcpack . Double-click or tap the file to automatically import it into Minecraft. In Minecraft, navigate to Settings > Global Resources > My Packs . Select ZenXveda: Unbound Shaders and click Activate . Set your in-game Graphics Mode to Deferred Technical Preview (if supported by your device) or standard Fancy Graphics for maximum performance.

fullDescription: Corrupted Visuals 1.1.0 A calmer, more natural daytime look. Changes Less oversaturated: default colours are toned down (about 108% instead of 136%). title: Glass Shields: Yours & Others
description: Minecraft Bedrock向けリソースパック。詳しい説明・対応バージョンは取得できた情報を掲載します。
compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: Turns shields into glass, so a raised shield no longer hides what is in front of you. Two packs in one download Opening the .mcaddon installs two packs. Glass Shield: Yours. The main pack. Changes your own shield in first person. Glass Shield: Others. Changes the shields you see other players and mobs holding. Turning it on adds Yours automatically. How to use Only your shield: turn on Yours. Both: turn on Others too, and pick a look in each one's settings. They can look different, for example clear glass for yours and red stained glass for others. Only other players' shields: turn on both and set Yours to Normal shield. 19 choices Normal shield (no glass). This one is at the top of the list. Glass: frame only, half see-through, faint tint. Stained glass: white, light blue, blue, purple, red, yellow, green, black. Art: diamond mosaic, red cross, blue stripes, creeper, rainbow, sky fade. Glass (recommended). This is the last one in the list, so it is selected automatically. Notes Resource pack only. No behaviour pack, no scripts, no commands. Achievements are unaffected. This only changes how shields look. Blocking, durability and hit detection are exactly the same as vanilla. Banner patterns are not shown on the shield while this pack is active. The game draws them with a solid material, so they cannot show through glass. Clear Shield (my other pack) changes the same shield files. If both are on, the one higher in the list wins. Nothing breaks, just use the one you like. Important: Minecraft updates can change how shields are drawn. If the shield looks wrong after an update, check for a new version of this pack. The pack names and descriptions are translated into all 29 languages Minecraft offers. All looks work on every device, including phones and tablets. Installation Download the .mcaddon and open it. Both packs are installed at once. Enable Yours (and Others if you want) under Global Resources in settings, then pick a look from the dropdown. If the .mcaddon does not open on your device, download the two .mcpack files from Additional Files instead. Author: kentotukun 日本語 盾をガラスにして、構えても前が見えるようにします。 1回のダウンロードで2つ入ります .mcaddon を開くと、2つのパックが入ります。 ガラスの盾：自分の盾。メインのパックです。一人称で見た自分の盾を変えます。 ガラスの盾：相手の盾。他のプレイヤーやモブが持っている盾を変えます。有効にすると「自分の盾」も自動で入ります。 使い方 自分の盾だけ：「自分の盾」を有効にします。 両方：「相手の盾」も有効にして、それぞれの設定（歯車）で見た目を選びます。自分は透明なガラス、相手は赤い色ガラス、のように別々にできます。 相手の盾だけ：両方を有効にして、「自分の盾」を「普通の盾」にします。 全19種類 普通の盾（ガラスにしない）。リストの一番上です。 ガラス：枠だけ、半透明、うっすら色付き。 色ガラス：白、水色、青、紫、赤、黄、緑、黒。 模様：ひし形モザイク、赤い十字、青の斜めしま、クリーパー、虹、空のグラデーション。 ガラス（おすすめ）。リストの一番下なので、最初からこれが選ばれています。 注意 リソースパックだけです。ビヘイビアーパック・スクリプト・コマンドは入っていません。実績は無効になりません。 変わるのは見た目だけです。防御・耐久値・当たり判定はバニラと同じです。 このパックを入れている間、盾の旗の模様は表示されません。ゲームが模様を不透明な材質で描くので、ガラスの中に透かせないためです。 透ける盾（Clear Shield、私の別のパック）は同じ盾のファイルを変えます。両方を有効にすると、リストで上にある方が使われます。壊れることはないので、好きな方を使ってください。 重要：Minecraft のアップデートで盾の描き方が変わると、表示がおかしくなることがあります。そのときは、新しい版が出ていないか確認してください。 パック名と説明は、Minecraft で選べる全29言語に翻訳しています。スマホやタブレットを含むどの端末でも、すべての見た目が使えます。 入れ方 .mcaddon をダウンロードして開きます。2つのパックが一度に入ります。設定の「グローバルリソース」で「自分の盾」（必要なら「相手の盾」も）を有効にして、ドロップダウンで見た目を選びます。 .mcaddon が開けない端末では、「追加ファイル」から .mcpack を2つダウンロードしてください。 作者：kentotukun

fullDescription: # oSkullo's Durability Armor HUD — v2.0.0 The HUD has been rebuilt on the new OS ArmorHUD engine. You get more display options and a simpler settings menu. ## Added - Layout dropdown: Vertical or Horizontal, each with or without a background. - Durability Style dropdown: Percent, Durability Bar, real durability (421/422) on the Left or Right side of the icon, or Off. - Number Color: choose colored numbers (by durability) or plain white. - Show Empty Slots: keep the hotbar cell visible when no armor is worn in that slot. - Offhand slot: shows while holding a totem or shield (Show Offhand toggle). - Low Durability Warning: a red ! on the armor icon, a top-center card, both, or off. - Show Armor HUD master toggle to switch the whole HUD on or off. ## Changed - Position is now two sliders: Position X (-400 to 400) and Position Y (-150 to 150). - The HUD now has its own rendering, so it layers more cleanly on screen. - The Armor HUD code now follows the `os:` naming throughout. - Minimum game version is now 1.21.130. ## Removed - The old per-part sliders: Group X/Y, Background X/Y/Size, Icon Size, Bar X/Y/Size and Number X/Y/Size. - The old Arrangement slider and the show/hide toggles for background, bar and numbers. The Layout and Durability Style dropdowns replace them. ## Notes - Your old settings won't carry over. Everything resets to the new defaults the first time you load the pack. - The HUD is still drawn in the world, so Minecraft draws the first-person hand and held item over it. Use Position X/Y to move the HUD clear of your hand.

fullDescription: Astrelle Shader — v1.0 An original, medium-vibrant shader for Minecraft Bedrock 1.21+, built to make vanilla worlds feel warmer and more alive without going overboard. Features: 🌅 Warm, cinematic sun and moon lighting with smooth sunrise/sunset color transitions (sun illuminance capped for balanced exposure, no blown-out highlights) 🎨 Moderate ACES-based color grading — richer saturation and contrast in highlights and midtones, tuned warm color temperature ☁️ Soft volumetric atmospherics with layered sky scattering for depth at dawn and dusk 💧 Realistic water with full wave simulation, dynamic caustics, physically-based reflection (fresnel + sun/moon specular highlights) and refraction (accurate index of refraction, underwater distortion and blur) 🐊 Biome-aware water and fog: murky green, low-visibility swamps; deep saturated blue oceans and rivers with stronger waves 🏜️ Warmer desert & mesa lighting for that golden, sun-baked feel ✨ Refined PBR fallback values for subtly improved surface reflectivity across blocks, actors, particles, and items 🌑 Soft shadows enabled Design philosophy: Astrelle aims for "beautiful, not blinding" — enhancements are deliberately restrained so the shader stays performant and doesn't wash out builds with excessive bloom or oversaturation. Compatible with Minecraft Bedrock 1.21+. Fully original work — no copied assets, textures, or third-party licensed content. Version 1.0 — initial release. Created by Dark_PixelForge

fullDescription: ⚡ Quick Actions Move and craft faster on Minecraft Bedrock, with no shift-clicking. Quick Actions adds a Quick Move toggle and a Fast Craft button to your UI. It's built to work cleanly with popular container add-ons. ✨ Features • Quick Move toggle: switch it on, then tap any item slot to send the whole stack to the other inventory. The toggle shows ON or OFF so you always know its state. • Fast Craft button (⚡): sits next to the crafting output in the crafting table, inventory crafting and stonecutter. One tap crafts the result and sends it to your inventory. • Double-tap move: double-tap a slot to move its stack (Standard subpack). • Smart toggle placement: the toggle appears only where you actually move items. Machine screens like furnaces, drives and generators stay clean. 📦 Where the toggle appears • Vanilla chests, double chests, trapped chests, ender chests, barrels and shulker boxes • Project Chest • Barrel Expansion • Better Containers (chests, double chests, barrels, shulkers) • UtilityCraft Digital Storage: Storage Terminal and Crafting Terminal ⚙️ Subpacks Choose one in the pack settings: • Standard (recommended): toggle + fast craft + double-tap move • Quick Move toggle only • Fast Craft only • Always Quick Move: every container, no toggle 📥 Installation Download the .mcpack and open it with Minecraft. Activate it in your world's Resource Packs. Place Quick Actions above Project Chest, Barrel Expansion, Better Containers and UtilityCraft Digital Storage in the pack list. This is required for compatibility. ❓ FAQ The toggle isn't showing on a container. Make sure Quick Actions is above the other packs. If it's still missing, report the container's name in the comments. Does it work on mobile? Yes, it was built and tested for the mobile UI. 🐞 Feedback Found a container that should have the toggle, or a UI problem? Leave a comment with a screenshot.

title: Vanilla Fog Reimagined+ v1.0
description: Explore a world filled with atmosphere! From peaceful plains to mysterious forests, Vanilla Fog Reimagined+ brings a fresh feel to the familiar Minecraft world, making every biome a little more memorable.
compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: Vanilla Fog Reimagined+ Welcome to a fresh way of experiencing Minecraft! Minecraft's world is full of incredible places, from wide-open plains and peaceful forests to deep caves and distant landscapes. But sometimes, it's the little details that make exploring those places even more enjoyable. That's where Vanilla Fog Reimagined+ comes in! This pack reimagines Minecraft's vanilla fog to give the world a more lively, immersive atmosphere without losing the familiar feeling that makes Minecraft special. Each environment gets its own atmospheric touch, helping landscapes feel more distinctive and giving your adventures a fresh visual experience. Whether you're wandering through a quiet forest, crossing an open desert, exploring underground caves, or building somewhere you can call home, the atmosphere becomes part of the experience. With 61 reimagined biomes, each bringing its own atmospheric touch, Vanilla Fog Reimagined+ gives Minecraft's familiar landscapes a fresh identity. Two ways to experience the world Vanilla Fog Reimagined+ comes with two subpacks, allowing you to choose how much fog you want in your world. Less Foggy — Clearer Views Prefer seeing more of the world around you? This option reduces fog density, giving you a clearer view of distant landscapes and surroundings while keeping the reimagined atmosphere. Perfect for players who enjoy exploring, building, and appreciating the details of their surroundings without too much fog getting in the way. More Foggy — Cozy and Immersive Want a stronger atmospheric experience? More Foggy increases the fog to create a more noticeable sense of depth and distance. Enjoy a cozier atmosphere, more distinctive landscapes, and a world that feels a little more mysterious. It's a great choice for players who love immersive environments and atmospheric exploration. Made for the Vanilla Experience The goal isn't to turn Minecraft into a completely different game. It's to take something already familiar and give it a fresh identity. - Reimagined vanilla fog. - Carefully adjusted atmospheric colors. - Two different fog experiences to choose from. - Designed to preserve Minecraft's familiar visual identity. - Suitable for exploration, building, survival, and everyday gameplay. Rediscover Your World Sometimes, a small change can make a familiar world feel like somewhere new. Take a walk through your favorite biome, watch the horizon, explore somewhere you've never been, or simply enjoy the atmosphere around your builds. Vanilla Fog Reimagined+ — Rediscover the atmosphere of Minecraft.

What it does Turns off particles (smoke, flames, bubbles, potion effects and more) Makes distant fog closer, so less far-away terrain is visible Simplifies leaves, grass and water textures Mutes some ambient background sounds Trims some item and menu effects Modes Open the pack's gear icon and choose a mode: Stable: lightest changes, closest to normal gameplay Rush: more fog and a bigger FPS boost Nitro: strongest boost, fog is closest and rain and snow streaks are removed If you're not sure, start with Stable. Move up a mode if you want more FPS. Good to know Boostify is a resource pack. It hides or removes effects, and it can't change how Minecraft itself renders, so gains are modest and vary by device, world and render distance. The stronger modes reduce visual quality. That's the trade-off. Works on Minecraft Bedrock 1.20.30 and newer. How to install Download the .mcpack file and open it. Minecraft will import it. Go to Settings → Global Resources and activate Boostify. Tap the gear icon next to the pack to choose a mode. fullDescription: Clear Transparent Inventory makes the inventory interface in Minecraft Bedrock fully clean and transparent, and also provides a simple way to add your own background images. Important note: By default this pack is shipped completely empty (no pre-installed wallpapers). When installed as-is, the inventory background becomes fully transparent. The built-in subpacks (dark, light, minimalist) are ready-made templates — just insert your own .png images into them and switch between them in-game at any time. What it does: - Fully transparent background — removes the solid black/gray rectangle behind the player model and inventory window so you can clearly see the world around you. - Clean interface and slots — makes the inventory panel and hotbar slots semi-transparent and less cluttered for better visibility. Perfect for: - PvP and BedWars players who need full situational awareness while managing inventory. - Players who prefer a clean, minimalist interface without the heavy default gray background. - Anyone who wants custom inventory wallpapers without creating UI JSON files from scratch. If you only want a transparent inventory You don't have to read further — just install the pack and you're done. --- Step 1: Unpack and replace the background image 1. Rename the .mcpack file to .zip and unpack it into a separate folder. 2. Go into one of the subpack folders, for example: subpacks/dark/textures/ui/ (or light / minimal) 3. Replace the file dialog_background_opaque.png with your own image. Important: The image must be in .png format and keep the exact same filename: dialog_background_opaque.png 4. (Optional) You can also edit dialog_background_opaque.json. This file controls how the image is stretched and scaled. If your image has a specific resolution (for example 1280×1088), open the .json file and update the "base_size" values: "base_size": [1280, 1088] Note: Do not replace files in the root textures/ui/ folder. Always work only inside the subpack folders to keep the pack stable. --- Step 2: Rename or add new subpacks (optional) How to rename a subpack (example: dark → scare): 1. Rename the folder: subpacks/dark → subpacks/scare 2. Open manifest.json and find the corresponding entry: { "folder_name": "dark", "name": "Dark" } 3. Change both values to the new name: { "folder_name": "scare", "name": "scare" } 4. Save the file. How to add a new subpack: 1. Create a new folder inside subpacks, for example: subpacks/my_bg 2. Copy the entire textures folder from an existing subpack (e.g. subpacks/dark) into the new folder. 3. Go to subpacks/my_bg/textures/ui/ and replace dialog_background_opaque.png with your image. 4. Open manifest.json and add a new entry to the "subpacks" array: { "folder_name": "my_bg", "name": "my_bg" } 5. Save the file. --- Important note about UUIDs If you customized the pack (replaced dialog_background_opaque.png) and already have the original version installed, it is strongly recommended to change one digit in each of the two UUID values in manifest.json. This prevents Minecraft from treating your customized pack as a duplicate of the original. If you have never installed the original pack, you can skip this step. --- Step 3: Pack and install 1. Go back to the root folder of the pack (you should see the textures and subpacks folders + manifest.json and pack_icon.png). 2. Select all these items together (do not select the outer parent folder) and compress them into a .zip archive. 3. Rename the .zip file back to .mcpack. 4. Open the .mcpack file to import it into Minecraft. 5. Go to Settings → Global Resources (or the resource packs of your world). 6. Find the pack and open its settings (the three-line icon or settings button next to it). In the subpack selection window, switch the slider to choose the subpack that contains your custom image After that the new background will be applied. You can switch between subpacks at any time through the same gear menu without reinstalling the pack.

fullDescription: BetterHitSounds for Bedrock Make every hit feel satisfying. BetterHitSounds replaces the default attack sounds in Minecraft Bedrock Edition with a punchy custom hit sound, with no mods or add-ons needed. Features Custom hit sound whenever you land a hit Slight random pitch on every hit, so it never sounds repetitive Critical hits get their own louder, higher-pitched version Missed swings keep the vanilla sound, so only real hits play it Lightweight resource pack that only changes what you hear How to install Open the .mcpack file to import it into Minecraft. If you hear no change, check that the pack isn't below another pack that changes sounds, and that your Players volume slider isn't at zero. Credits and original project This pack is a Bedrock port of the Fabric mod BetterHitSounds, licensed CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://github.com/hardik-verma/BetterHitSounds The hit sound comes from the original mod. Developed by super ores developer, aka Rouver Cabriana. How this project differs from the original The original is a Java Edition Fabric mod with a config screen, a combo pitch ramp, crit boost and distance falloff. This is a Bedrock Edition resource pack, so it needs no mod and no code. It only replaces Bedrock's own attack sounds, with random pitch variation and a louder, higher-pitched sound on crits. It has no settings screen, no combo system and no distance scaling, because resource packs can't do those.

fullDescription: This texture pack reverts most of the Minecraft textures to their earliest versions based on all of the information of these textures on the internet. Changes: Most of the textures were changed to their earliest versions from the texture atlases or from older versions of the default resource pack. The earliest versions of some textures were found on the internet, recreated based on information available on the internet, or taken from other sources. The grass, leaves, and other foliage have been changed to be the same neon green color all biomes because the old grass and leaves textures were the save neon green color in all biomes. The water has been changed to be the same deep blue color in all biomes because the old water texture was the same deep blue color in all biomes. Credits: Most of the textures that were introduced in later versions of Minecraft before the Village and Pillage update were taken from an earlier version of the Minecraft Bedrock Vanilla Resource Pack. ( https://github.com/ZtechNetwork/MCBVanillaResourcePack/releases/tag/v1.9.0.5 ) The textures that never appeared in any build of Minecraft Java or Minecraft Bedrock came from the History of Textures page on the Minecraft Wiki ( https://minecraft.wiki/w/History_of_textures ) The early candle textures were also taken from the Minecraft Wiki ( https://minecraft.wiki/w/Candle ) The older textures were taken from the Minecraft Texture Atlases which were shown in the Minecraft Wiki ( https://minecraft.wiki/w/Texture_atlas ) Some of the prototype item textures were recreated based on invisible colored pixels in some of the programmer art item textures, and this information came from the Minecraft Wiki. The recreations of the prototype dye textures and prototype iron golem textures were taken directly from the Minecraft Wiki. ( https://minecraft.wiki/w/Unused_textures/Hidden_in_transparency ) The glass texture was taken from a Reddit post which was posted by u/Adam_Hero1 in the r/GoldenAgeMinecraft subreddit. ( https://www.reddit.com/r/GoldenAgeMinecraft/comments/1t9gzat/i_have_recreated_the_classic_glass_texture_from/ ) The stone bricks texture was recreated based on the information from a video posted by _jspecter which explains which textures were used to make most of the other programmer art textures and how the textures were edited to create the derivative textures. At 5:15 in the video, _jspector explains that the fact that the grain in the stone bricks texture is misaligned indicates that the texture was adjusted after the original stone bricks texture was created and shows what the original stone bricks texture would have looked like. ( https://youtu.be/P6BvcLnESIM ) The sand texture is an edited version of one of the sand textures that was shown in _jspecter's video. ( https://youtu.be/P6BvcLnESIM ) The textures that did not have earlier versions were taken from the latest version of the Vanilla Resource Pack ( https://github.com/Mojang/bedrock-samples/releases/tag/v1.26.50.4 )

fullDescription: HazzMCx Tweaks Rebuilt Once an experiment. Now refined -- HazzMCx Tweaks - v1.5.0 The project continues to refine its existing visuals, removing an unnecessary UI element and improving the Hotbar Texture for a cleaner appearance. UI Removed Circle Touch Refined the Hotbar Texture -- HazzMCx Tweaks - v1.4.0 The Cushion collection has now been completed, expanding the texture introduced in v1.3.0 into a full set of all 16 Minecraft colors. Added the remaining Cushion color variations to complete the full 16 color set Added White XP Bar with fixed White XP Text -- HazzMCx Tweaks - v1.3.0 The project expanded its customization with another new decorative texture. Added New Cushion Texture Currently available in Black, Light Gray, and White -- HazzMCx Tweaks - v1.2.0 The pack continued developing its own visual direction. Added New Hotbar Texture Added PBR Textures for Gold Crown, Netherite Crown & Elytra Added Low Fire Texture -- HazzMCx Tweaks - v1.1.0 The project began moving further away from its original foundation and introduced several new additions. Added No Particle / Default Subpacks Added Netherite Crown Added Borders for Gravel & Sand -- HazzMCx Tweaks - v1.0.0 The first version still relied heavily on selected textures from the original Bedrock Tweaks collection. These were retained as the foundation while the project began developing its own identity. UI Title PNG Blocky Font Smaller Crosshair Clear Spyglass Scope Splash Texts / Tags Armor Golden Crown New Elytra Model Blocks Borderless Glass -- The Beginning HazzMCx Tweaks originated from BedrockTweaks.net , a website that allows Minecraft Bedrock players to create their own Resource Packs by selecting from a variety of available textures and tweaks. This became the foundation of what would eventually become HazzMCx Tweaks . What started as a collection of selected Bedrock Tweaks gradually became an experiment to develop a Resource Pack with its own identity. -- The Old Generation Before HazzMCx Tweaks Rebuilt , the project had already been published publicly. The old project was uploaded with an early version of the pack and was downloaded by 51 people . At the time, the project was still in an experimental stage. The release was essentially an early, raw version of the project rather than the more organized version history that exists today. The old release became an important part of the project's history. It showed that HazzMCx Tweaks had already reached other players, while also revealing the need for a cleaner structure, clearer versioning, and a more mature development process. Those 51 downloads are not being erased from the story. They are part of where HazzMCx Tweaks came from. -- HazzMCx Tweaks Rebuilt This project represents a new generation derived from the original project . Rather than continuing the old project with its inconsistent history, the pack is being rebuilt from its foundation with a cleaner structure and a more consistent versioning system. The new generation starts again from v1.0.0 , allowing each version to be properly documented and developed in sequence. The purpose of Rebuilt is not to pretend the old project never existed. It is to take what was created before, preserve its roots, and build it again into something more refined and mature. The old project was the experiment. Rebuilt is the continuation of what that experiment became. -- Once an experiment. Now refined

fullDescription: This is an FPS Boost pack focused on removing particles , fog , and unnecessary animations . It works on all devices and can help reduce lag for a smoother gameplay experience. For the best performance, I recommend using it together with Lithium Reversed and Sodium GL to get even higher FPS. What Does This Pack Remove ? This pack removes unnecessary animations and effects such as campfire smoke, fire, stonecutter animations, underwater bubbles, Nether particles, and more. Don't worry. No player or mob animations have been removed. This pack does not replace any textures, so it should not cause conflicts with other texture packs. You can safely use it with Bare Bones and other texture packs. Only two textures, water and lava, have been optimized. Fast Better Grass This pack also includes Fast Better Grass to optimize the rendering of the ground. I did not create Fast Better Grass myself, but I decided to use it because of its quality and accuracy. It works well with different texture packs and keeps the ground rendering optimized. Thanks to the original creator of Fast Better Grass . Key Features Fog : More than 102 fog effects have been removed or optimized, including Nether fog, underwater fog, lava fog, rain fog, and other environmental fog effects. Particles : More than 199 particles have been removed from the game, which is more than most FPS Boost packs. All particle amounts are set to 0, so you don't have to worry about any particles remaining. Animations : More than 40 unnecessary animations have been removed, including lava, water, fire, campfire, Warden Sonic Boom, rain, and more. Why Remove These Effects? Particles : Heavy particle effects, such as explosions, can cause performance issues on weaker devices. Large amounts of particles may even cause crashes in some situations. By removing them, situations such as fighting the Wither can become much smoother and more optimized. Fog : Removing annoying fog effects, such as Nether fog, underwater fog, lava fog, rain, and storms, can make the game clearer and more enjoyable to play. Animations : Some animations and effects, such as Nether particles and campfire smoke, can contribute to lag. Removing them makes the game cleaner, lighter, and smoother. Credits Made by Grave Herald . I hope you can enjoy Minecraft with less lag .

fullDescription: ARCHIVED ⚡ RenderRush+ V3.1.0 — FPS Booster for Minecraft Bedrock edition. ⚡ RenderRush+ Quick Summary · 🚀 Boosts FPS helps Minecraft Bedrock run smoother on low-end and mid-range devices · 🎚️ 3 performance tiers Balanced, FPS Boost, and Ultra FPS for different devices · 🧱 Keeps the vanilla look cleaner textures without changing the game’s style · 📱 Great for mobile & low-end PCs made for players who need better performance · ✅ Simple & compatible easy to install and built for Bedrock 1.21.40+. Want a smoother Minecraft Bedrock experience without completely sacrificing the vanilla feel? Meet RenderRush+, a client-side performance resource pack designed to reduce selected particle effects, simplify demanding visuals, and optimize certain animations and rendering options. Whether you're playing on a budget Android phone, an older tablet, or simply want a cleaner Minecraft experience, RenderRush+ gives you three optimization tiers so you can choose the right balance between visuals and performance. No unnecessary complexity. No custom audio silencing. Just performance-focused visual optimizations! 💚 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🎮 THREE OPTIMIZATION TIERS 🌿 1. Balanced FPS — Keep the Vanilla Feel Best for players who prefer Minecraft's original visuals. Want fewer heavy particles without making the game look completely different? Balanced FPS is designed to preserve the familiar vanilla experience while reducing selected particle effects. ✨ Features: - 💨 Disables 42 targeted particle definitions. - 🎆 Caps 3 additional particle effects. - 🌳 Keeps vanilla foliage textures and leaf shapes. - ☁️ Retains clouds, terrain shadows, directional shadows, and entity shadows. - 🌊 Keeps fancy water enabled. - 🎨 Avoids the more aggressive biome, fog, and texture changes used by the higher tiers. Ideal for: Players who want a subtle optimization with minimal visual changes. ⚡ 2. FPS Boost — The Everyday Choice Recommended for everyday gameplay! Looking for a balance between performance and visual clarity? FPS Boost takes optimization further by reducing selected particle effects, simplifying animations, and disabling several costly rendering options. 🔥 Features: - 💨 Optimizes selected particle effects while retaining important gameplay cues at reduced rates where supported. - 🌊 Includes water and environmental color adjustments. - 🌫️ Adds custom biome fog profiles. - 🔥 Reduces selected animated textures with 29 additional animation changes. - ☁️ Disables clouds, terrain shadows, directional shadows, reflections, and fancy water. - 👥 Retains entity shadows. - 🔊 Preserves normal Minecraft audio, including Warden warnings, rain, and portal sounds. Ideal for: Survival, PvP, general exploration, and everyday play when you want a stronger optimization without removing every visual cue. 🔥 3. Ultra FPS — Maximum Visual Reduction For players who want the most aggressive optimization tier. Ultra FPS pushes the visual reductions further. It removes many more targeted particle effects, simplifies selected plant textures, and disables additional rendering features to minimize visual overhead where possible. ⚙️ Features: - 💨 Disables 192 targeted particle emitters. - 🔥 Applies the same additional animation reductions as FPS Boost. - 🍃 Uses opaque foliage textures for selected leaves and plants. - ☁️ Disables clouds and fancy water. - 🌑 Disables terrain, directional, and entity shadows. - ✨ Disables selected reflections, atmospheric effects, and other rendering features. ⚠️ Important: Ultra FPS removes more visual feedback, including particle effects that can help communicate certain gameplay events. Some scenes may benefit more than others. Ideal for: Lower-end devices and particle-heavy situations where minimizing visual effects matters more than preserving every detail. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🛠️ WHAT MAKES RENDERRUSH+ DIFFERENT? 💨 Particle Optimization Targets selected heavy particle effects to reduce unnecessary visual activity. 🔥 Animation Optimization Reduces selected animated textures to simplify parts of the visual workload. 🌫️ Environment Adjustments FPS Boost and Ultra FPS include custom biome fog profiles and environmental color changes. 🌳 Foliage Simplification Ultra FPS uses selected opaque plant and leaf textures for a more performance-focused appearance. ⚙️ Rendering Optimizations Each tier uses different cloud, shadow, and water-rendering settings to suit its optimization level. 🔊 Normal Audio Preserved RenderRush+ does not silence Minecraft's audio. Warden warnings, weather, portals, and other normal game sounds remain intact. 📦 Three Selectable Subpacks Choose the optimization level that matches your device and visual preferences. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📱 WHO IS RENDERRUSH+ FOR? ✅ Players using budget or older mobile devices ✅ Players experiencing heavy particle effects ✅ PvP and survival players who prefer a cleaner screen ✅ Players looking for a lightweight client-side resource pack ✅ Anyone who wants to choose between vanilla-like visuals and aggressive visual reduction ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ PERFORMANCE & COMPATIBILITY 📈 Your FPS results will vary. Improvements depend on your device, graphics settings, world, and the effects currently being rendered. Gains may be more noticeable during particle-heavy situations than during ordinary exploration. RenderRush+ is a client-side resource pack. It does not directly optimize chunk meshing, entity AI, simulation distance, networking, redstone, farms, or server-side processing. It cannot guarantee a specific FPS increase. 🎮 Minecraft Bedrock Edition: The pack's declared minimum engine version is 1.21.120. Some newer particle and biome assets target content from later releases, so individual features may vary by game version. Full in-game compatibility across versions has not been verified. 💡 Our recommendation: Start with FPS Boost. Switch to Balanced FPS for a more vanilla-like experience, or Ultra FPS when you want the strongest visual reductions. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 💚 CREDITS Inspired by the original RenderRush V1 by @AllayMC. ⚡ Remade, tweaked, and improved by @Mingo14. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚡ RenderRush+ Render Less. Play Smoother. Three tiers. Your choice. Your gameplay. 🚀

fullDescription: AxyBoost — Performance Resource Pack Maximum Performance. Smooth Gameplay. Vanilla Quality. AxyBoost is a performance-focused Minecraft Java Edition resource pack designed to help create a smoother, more stable, and responsive gameplay experience on low-end PCs, potato computers, and Android devices running Java Edition through compatible launchers. Built around the philosophy of optimizing without ruining the visuals, AxyBoost aims to preserve Minecraft’s recognizable vanilla appearance while reducing unnecessary visual overhead through carefully selected asset optimizations. The goal is to balance maximum practical FPS, visual clarity, and a clean, attractive Minecraft experience without making textures blurry or sacrificing quality unnecessarily. Key Goals and Features - FPS-Focused Optimization: Target unnecessary visual overhead and resource-intensive assets where resource-pack changes can provide meaningful benefits. - Sharp Vanilla Visuals: Preserve Minecraft’s original texture style, recognizable blocks, items, and environments. - Low-End Device Friendly: Designed with limited hardware resources in mind, including budget PCs and compatible Android Java Edition setups. - Balanced Performance: Offers a development direction that prioritizes smoother gameplay while preserving visual quality wherever possible. - Reduced Visual Clutter: Aim to simplify selected unnecessary visual effects without removing important gameplay information. - Compatibility-Focused Design: Targets Minecraft Java Edition versions 1.21 through 26.3, with version-specific validation required before claiming full compatibility. - Single-Player and Multiplayer: Intended for client-side use without requiring server installation for ordinary resource-pack features. - No Gameplay Changes: A resource pack focused on visual assets rather than changing Minecraft’s core mechanics. What About CPU, GPU, Memory, and TPS? AxyBoost focuses on the aspects of performance that a resource pack can influence. Texture dimensions, transparency, animations, and other visual assets may affect rendering cost or memory use, depending on the hardware and situation. However, a resource pack cannot directly optimize CPU scheduling, Java memory management, server tick performance (TPS), or network latency. Further improvements in those areas require suitable game settings, performance mods, or server-side optimization. The AxyBoost Philosophy You should not have to make Minecraft look terrible just to make it run better. title: LIVELY VISUALS
description: Original Bedrock Vibrant Visuals settings for cinematic dawn shafts, biome-tinted skies, readable shadows, soft mist, cool nights, and calmer water. By GURJAR.
compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: LIVELY VISUALS is an original Bedrock visual-settings resource pack by GURJAR, created for worlds using Vibrant Visuals. Its art direction is cinematic yet readable: preserve the familiar block-built world, then shape its mood with daylight color, atmospheric depth, soft contrast, and clearer moving water. The pack does not replace terrain, add structures, or reproduce any supplied screenshot. Across forests and jungles, the profile balances evergreen shade with a gentle leaf-toned ambient lift. Warm directional light and restrained scattering can reveal shafts through canopy gaps when the camera, weather, and geometry allow. Forest water receives a subtle cool-green character, modest surface motion, and the game’s built-in caustic effect underwater. Cherry groves and flower-rich scenes receive a rose-and-lilac atmosphere. Dawn and sunset shift toward soft pink, while daytime stays bright enough to preserve pale blossoms and block textures. Saturation is raised cautiously so petals stand out without turning foliage neon. Plains, savannas, and village settings lean into honeyed sunlight, warm lantern accents, and readable cool shade. Badlands and desert terrain use copper, terracotta, and burnt-orange tones, with a restrained horizon glow that keeps cliff edges and alcoves visible instead of flattening them into red. Water and underwater spaces are part of the scene rather than a separate filter. The presets favor clean blue, turquoise, or green-blue appearances by biome family, with calmer waves intended to add movement without hiding the block palette. Caustics use Minecraft’s built-in rendering resource; no copied caustic image is included. Underwater fog stays blue and moderately transparent, allowing ruins, plants, and lanterns to remain readable while light shafts appear only where the renderer and scene support them. Cold mountains use crisp blue daylight and cool shadows. Flower gardens can use a softer mist profile, while caves receive conservative ambient lift so contrast remains useful during play. Night settings favor deep blue skies, pale moonlight, and visible silhouettes rather than crushed black. Across the pack, color grading is restrained: highlights retain detail, shadows keep texture, and the block-based visual language remains recognizable. LIVELY VISUALS is a resource-pack configuration, not a replacement graphics engine, universal shader injector, or promise of identical screenshots on every device. Results depend on game build, supported hardware, Vibrant Visuals availability, graphics preset, biome, time, weather, resource-pack order, and the camera’s view of the sun. Activate the pack and select Vibrant Visuals in Video settings. Use the modern package on supported stable versions; the separate 1.21.80 build is an experimental legacy profile for builds where that renderer accepts resource-pack settings. The design began from nine user-provided references, studied for broad qualities such as dawn direction, forest contrast, sunset hue, underwater shafts, mist, and night color. Those images are not included, and no third-party shader code, texture, logo, or screenshot has been copied into this pack. The settings, profile names, icon artwork, short description, and image prompts were created specifically for LIVELY VISUALS. The pack adds atmosphere without changing gameplay, world generation, or player-built structures, so it can be tried in an existing world after making a backup. For publication, identify the creator as GURJAR and the project as LIVELY VISUALS. This is an independent fan-made resource pack, not an official Minecraft product. Before publishing, select a distribution license and upload version that match your plans and CurseForge’s current requirements. Test the exact release file on the game versions and devices you list, and invite users to report issues with their device, game version, graphics mode, and active packs. The goal is a more expressive world that remains unmistakably Minecraft: warm light, cool shade, clear water, richer color, and room for each player’s own creation to shine.

fullDescription: No Particles FPS Tired of lag spikes, screen clutter, and unnecessary visual effects? No Particles FPS removes all non-essential particles from Minecraft Bedrock, giving you a cleaner screen, smoother gameplay, and significantly improved performance, especially on low-end and mobile devices. This pack is designed for players who want maximum FPS and zero distractions, whether you're doing PVP, survival, or heavy exploration. 🌟 What It Does Particles Disabled All unnecessary particle effects like: -Smoke -Fire sparks -Hit particles -Dust, animations, and ambient effects are completely removed. This reduces GPU and CPU load, making Minecraft run much smoother without changing the core visuals of the game. Three Subpacks - Pick Your Level Choose your particle removal level directly on the pack. Go to Settings → Resource Packs , tap No Particles FPS , and use the slider to switch between three modes: Lite — Removes 47 heavy particles (weather, block breaking, all 8 falling dust types, campfire smoke, all 6 leaf particle types, flames, lava drips and all 5 portal effects). Keeps everything else vanilla. Best for players who want a noticeable FPS boost without losing the game's visual charm. Balanced — Removes 102 particles but keeps 90 essential gameplay particles like potion effects, redstone dust, fishing bobber, villager reactions, warden and sculk signals, trial chamber mechanics, breeze attacks, dragon fight effects, and crop growth feedback. On top of Lite it also clears bubbles, water splashes, explosions, drips and mob flames. Best for PVP and survival players who need visual cues but want smooth frames. Max FPS — Removes 187 particles and blanks 15 more textures: the particle atlases, the environment sheets and the enchantment glint. Everything except crit, totem and mob-growth feedback is gone. The full nuclear option for absolute maximum performance. This is the original No Particles FPS behavior. Clean & Clear Screen With particles gone, your screen stays: -More readable in fights -Clearer while mining or building -Less visually noisy Every mode also clears the pumpkin blur , so wearing a carved pumpkin no longer covers your screen. Perfect for PVP, speedrunning, and low-end devices. Maximum FPS Boost By removing thousands of particle draw calls, this pack: -Improves frame stability -Reduces lag spikes -Keeps your device cooler -Prevents thermal throttling on phones and tablets You get higher FPS and more consistent performance. Performance Friendly Sixteen of the seventeen textures this pack ships are 1×1 transparent images, and the last one is a reduced-opacity 32×32 weather sheet — so it takes essentially nothing off your RAM or VRAM budget and only ever removes work, never adds any. It works smoothly on: -Android -iOS -Windows Bedrock -Low-end phones & PCs No scripts. No behavior packs. Just pure performance. Full Compatibility No Particles FPS works with: -PVP texture packs -FPS boosters -UI packs -Shaders and Vibrant Visuals It only overrides particle definitions and a handful of textures, so it stacks cleanly with almost anything. Just place it above other resource packs so its particle overrides load correctly. -Minecraft Bedrock 1.21+, tested on 26.50 -Works on existing worlds, single-player, servers and Realms -No experimental features required No gameplay changes. No visual breakage. Just cleaner visuals and more FPS

fullDescription: RELAX VISUALS: Calm Skies, Clear Water, Quiet Nights RELAX VISUALS is a lighting and atmosphere pack for Minecraft Bedrock, built for Vibrant Visuals. It keeps the blocks, textures and feel of classic Minecraft and changes only the light around them. The result is relaxed and cinematic: cool teal-blue daytime skies, purple dusks with a glowing pale-gold sun, soft blue haze in the distance, clear turquoise water, and blue moonlit nights that stay bright enough to explore. Every biome gets its own colour of haze and sun rays, so each place has its own mood. What You Get Cool, clear daytime skies. The sky moves from a deep teal-blue at the top to a pale blue-grey haze near the horizon. Distant terrain fades into a soft blue tint, giving landscapes a strong sense of depth. A colour-grading pass boosts contrast and colour so greens, reds and blues stand out. Purple sunsets and sunrises. At dusk and dawn the sky turns deep violet and mauve while the sun glows a pale warm gold. The contrast makes sunsets striking and helps light shafts through trees stand out. Bright blue moonlit nights. Night skies are a soft blue-violet rather than pure black, with cool moonlight and purple-blue shadows. Lanterns, torches, candles and campfires glow warmly against the blue. Clear turquoise water. Water is tuned to be clean and bright, with a gentle tint from the surrounding biome, finer waves, and sharper, animated caustic patterns on the floor of shallow water. The caustics texture was created from scratch for this pack. Biome-coloured sun rays and haze. The pack tints the volumetric fog that carries the light shafts, so rays and haze take on the colour of the biome around you. It covers all 89 biomes with 39 hand-tuned light themes, including caves, oceans and the other dimensions. A few examples: Plains, Savanna and Desert: warm amber haze softened by cool distance tones Birch Forest and Flower Forest: soft peach mist Jungle and Bamboo Jungle: cool grey-green mist with green light shafts Swamp and Mangrove: thick yellow-green fog Taiga: gentle sage-green mist Snowy and Mountain Biomes: cool blue-lavender haze Oceans: aqua and deep blue Warm, coloured local lights. Torches, lanterns, campfires, candles, glowstone, lava and other light sources cast their own coloured light on nearby blocks. Soul torches glow blue, copper torches glow green, and amethyst glows violet. A violet End and a darker Nether. The End has a rich violet sky with a lavender glow. Each Nether biome has its own sky and glow, and Crimson Forest is deep red with a nearly black ceiling. Soft shadows and cinematic colour. Soft-edged shadows and a vivid colour-grading pass add depth without crushing shadows or blowing out highlights. Two Versions RELAX VISUALS: the main pack, with rich haze and colour. RELAX VISUALS (Soft): the same look with lighter haze and gentler rays, for a more natural feel. How to Use It Import the .mcpack file by tapping or double-clicking it. Do not unzip it into a folder. Go to Settings, then Global Resources, and activate RELAX VISUALS. Turn on Vibrant Visuals in Video Settings. For the best rays and dusk colours, explore at sunrise or sunset, among trees, hills and mist. Tips Use only one Vibrant Visuals pack at a time to avoid conflicts. If the effect feels too strong, switch to the Soft version. This pack changes light, colour, sky, haze and water. Block textures and cloud shapes come from the game or from other packs you use. Compatibility Built for Minecraft Bedrock Edition and Pocket Edition, with Vibrant Visuals enabled. Vibrant Visuals pack features require version 1.21.120 or later. Vibrant Visuals does not exist in older versions of the game, so this pack’s lighting effects will not appear there. It needs a device that supports Vibrant Visuals, and performance depends on your hardware and render distance. Originality All configuration files, colour values, the caustics texture and the pack icon in this pack were made from scratch. It uses no textures, files or assets from other packs. title: Compatible
description: Compatible Shader recolours Minecraft's Vibrant Visuals light, haze and colour grading for each biome: pink cherry groves, vivid emerald forests, golden ice spikes and teal moonlit nights. One file, original work by GURJAR.

fullDescription: Compatible Shader is a bold colour-and-light add-on for Minecraft Bedrock Edition's Vibrant Visuals graphics mode. It does not replace textures or change gameplay. Instead it repaints the atmosphere: cherry groves glow pink, forests turn deep emerald, deserts blaze amber, snowy lands shine with golden light, and nights wash the world in cool teal moonlight. Each biome gets its own mood, so travelling across your world feels like walking through different paintings. The pack is built from four ideas. First, directional lighting: the sun and moon carry biome-specific colours that reach blocks, leaves, water and sky. Second, coloured volumetric haze: featured biomes receive a tinted fog that catches sunlight and turns it into visible beams between tree trunks, hills and clouds. Third, colour grading: every featured biome has its own saturation, warmth and tint, which makes greens vivid and pinks rich while keeping detail. Fourth, teal night lighting: moonlight shifts toward a glowing aqua-teal, giving lakes, swamps and villages a dreamy midnight look. Water is tuned too: clearer, richer colours, livelier waves and brighter caustic light patterns on the bottom. One single file is all you need. Compatible Shader is made to load on Minecraft Bedrock 1.21.100 and newer, including the 26.x releases, so you do not have to pick between several downloads. Because the pack has to work on every one of those versions, it keeps one steady colour tint through the day instead of changing colour at sunrise and sunset. Featured biomes are Cherry Grove, Forest, Flower Forest, Birch Forest, Old Growth Birch Forest, Plains, Sunflower Plains, Taiga, Old Growth Pine and Spruce Taiga, Snowy Taiga, Snowy Plains, Windswept Hills, Jungle, Bamboo Jungle, Sparse Jungle, Savanna and Desert. Other Overworld biomes keep their familiar look, but their sunlight and moonlight are re-tinted: Ice Spikes receive a warm golden light, Mushroom Fields a soft pearly lilac, Swamps a misty green-teal, and Badlands a coral glow. The Nether and the End are left untouched. Everything in the pack is original. It contains no copied shaders, textures or code. It is made entirely from official Vibrant Visuals data files that Minecraft already supports, namely lighting, fog, colour grading and client biome definitions, and every colour value was chosen by hand for this project. Light intensity follows the current vanilla scale, so exposure stays balanced. No mods, launchers, OptiFine or Iris are needed, and because the pack adds no heavy textures it asks for very little beyond what Vibrant Visuals already uses. How to install: open the downloaded file with Minecraft so it imports itself, then go to Settings, Global Resources and activate Compatible Shader. Next open Settings, Video and set Graphics Mode to Vibrant Visuals. For the strongest glow, raise the Bloom slider to 100 percent. Load a world and look toward the sun through trees or hills at sunrise or sunset for the best first impression. Please note what this pack cannot do. Resource packs cannot change cloud shapes, add lens flares, draw an aurora, alter rain shapes, or control the strength of bloom and blur. Those effects belong to Minecraft itself or to separate shader systems, so your game will show the colours and mood of the pack, not a copy of any particular shader. Vibrant Visuals must be turned on and supported by your device, or the pack will show no visible effect. Credits: created and designed by GURJAR. Minecraft and Vibrant Visuals belong to Mojang Studios and Microsoft. This pack is an independent fan-made creation and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Mojang or Microsoft. You may share it, but please keep the credit to GURJAR. Feature list Biome-specific sun and moon colours, with teal moonlight at night Coloured volumetric haze that turns sunlight into visible beams Per-biome colour grading (saturation, warmth, tint) for 18 featured biome types Tuned water: richer colours per biome, livelier waves and brighter caustics Re-tinted light for Ice Spikes, Mushroom Fields, Swamps and Badlands One single file for Bedrock 1.21.100 and newer, including 26.x Light intensity on the current vanilla scale Nether and End left untouched 100% original configuration, no copied shaders, textures or code No mods, launchers, OptiFine or Iris required Installation Download the file and open it with Minecraft so it imports itself. Settings > Global Resources > activate Compatible Shader. Settings > Video > Graphics Mode > Vibrant Visuals. Raise Bloom to 100% for the strongest glow. Load a world and look toward the sun at sunrise or sunset. Do not unzip the file into a folder by hand; opening it with Minecraft is the supported method. Recommended settings Graphics Mode: Vibrant Visuals Bloom: 100% (in the Vibrant Visuals options; names can vary slightly by version) Point Light Quality: High or Ultra if your device runs smoothly Clouds: Medium or higher Leave Gamma / brightness at default unless the image is too dark Known limitations Vibrant Visuals must be enabled and supported by your device. Water colour and waves are tuned for the featured biomes and the default water; special water such as warm oceans and swamps keeps its vanilla look. Resource packs cannot change cloud shapes, lens flares, aurora, rain shapes or the strength of bloom and blur. To work on every supported version, the pack keeps one colour tint all day (no separate sunrise/sunset colour). The pack replaces the client definition of its featured biome IDs. Those biomes keep default grass and foliage tint and default biome music. Early release: results can vary slightly by device and version. Credits and legal Created and designed by GURJAR. Vanilla RTX is the go-to ray tracing resource pack for Minecraft RTX, bringing together a cohesive art direction for default ray-traced Minecraft graphics since 2020 – Enabling players to use Minecraft's ray tracing features in any world or servers by adding thoughtfully-crafted materials and configurations to the base game without altering the vanilla experience, delivering complete ray tracing support for Minecraft in a manner that integrates seamlessly and maintains a native look and feel. Everything has been fine-tuned for Minecraft's ray tracing. Vanilla RTX Normals features handcrafted 16x normal maps instead, which simulate curvature by defining the direction each pixel in the texture is facing. Vanilla RTX Opus is the composition of both Vanilla RTX & Vanilla RTX Normals, featuring higher resolution normal maps with an unprecedented level of detail. title: BRG Arctic Horizon: Frost & Mist
description: viridusk visual reshapes the look of your world with a lush emerald-green atmosphere, warm golden-hour light, and soft, moody depth. Every sunrise, sunset, and night gets a more atmospheric feel while the game keeps its Minecraft charm.
compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: ❄ BRG Arctic Horizon ☀ Cool blue skies. Drifting white mist. Clean aqua water. A world that feels calm, cold and cinematic, without a heavy shader. ❄ Welcome to Arctic Horizon BRGamers Arctic Horizon is a lightweight, Arctic-inspired atmosphere pack for Minecraft Bedrock Edition . It keeps the classic blocky look you already love, then wraps your world in a cooler, mistier and more atmospheric mood. Distant mountains fade softly into a pale cyan haze, forests sit under drifting white mist, lakes turn a clean aqua blue, and the sky and moon get a fresh, polished look. Everything in this pack was made from scratch by BRGamers. It does not copy any other creator's files, textures or code. The pack is only about 250 KB , so it installs in seconds and is gentle on phones and tablets. ✦ Why You Will Like It Lightweight: a tiny download, no shader loader and no heavy effects. Vanilla-friendly: block textures are untouched, so your builds still look like Minecraft. Atmospheric: layered fog, mist and cool tints give the whole world a calm mood. Easy to install: open the file, activate it and play. Customizable: one number in a text file makes the fog lighter or thicker. 🌫 Layered Fog and Mist Fog is the heart of this pack. Instead of one flat fog for every biome, Arctic Horizon uses seven different fog styles , each tuned for the kind of place you are standing in. Fog starts far enough away that the terrain around you stays clear, then slowly thickens with distance so faraway hills and mountains melt into the horizon. White Mist: forests, birch forests, taiga, swamps, jungles, meadows and rivers get the thickest, softest mist. It starts close, so trees fade into a gentle white veil. Snow Haze: snowy plains, frozen rivers, groves and mountain peaks use a bright, pale-blue haze that feels crisp and cold. Open Sky Fog: plains, savannas and hills get a clean blue-white distance fade that keeps the view wide and open. Warm Haze: deserts and badlands use a slightly warmer pale haze, so they do not look unnaturally icy. Ocean Fog: oceans get a cool blue distance fade, and deep oceans use a darker, deeper tone with a longer view. Cave Fog: dripstone caves, lush caves and the deep dark get a cool, dark blue fog for a moody feeling underground. 🌊 Aqua Water Water uses a clean aqua-blue surface color with a slightly more transparent look, so lakes and rivers feel fresh instead of flat. Shallow biomes lean light and turquoise, while deep oceans use a darker, deeper blue. Underwater fog colors are tuned to match, so diving feels calm and consistent with the rest of the world. ☁ Soft Custom Clouds The clouds were redrawn as soft, tileable shapes with a faint cool tint. They sit nicely against the blue sky and fit the Arctic mood without looking harsh or noisy. ☀ Redrawn Sun with Light Rays The sun has a warm white-gold glow with thin rays of light spreading out from it. The rays pointing downward are the longest and brightest, so the sun looks like it is shining down over the land. Look toward the sun at sunrise or sunset to enjoy it. 🌙 Moon with 8 Phases The moon has a cool blue-white tone, soft crater detail and all eight phases. Nights keep a calm, moonlit feeling, and the moon looks great against the deep blue night sky. 🌿 Cool Natural Foliage Tints Grass, foliage, spruce and birch colormaps lean slightly cooler and fresher, so green areas match the blue sky and mist. The result is natural and balanced, with no neon colors. Cold biomes feel colder, and warm biomes stay green and healthy. ⚡ Performance Arctic Horizon is a normal resource pack, so it does not need a shader loader or any special render pass. The download is tiny, and it keeps all the vanilla block textures, so it is a good choice for Android phones, tablets and older devices. Results depend on your device, so there are no FPS promises here, but because nothing heavy is added, the pack is designed to stay light. 📦 Compatibility Edition: Minecraft Bedrock Edition (Android, iOS, Windows) Version: 1.21 and newer Vibrant Visuals: not required. Keep it off for the intended look. Shader loader: not required. Other packs: if another pack changes fog, sky or clouds, move Arctic Horizon above it in the list. 🛠 How to Install Download the .mcpack file. Open the file. Minecraft will import it automatically. Go to Settings → Global Resources . Activate BRGamers Arctic Horizon and move it to the top. Create or open a world and enjoy. Updating? Remove the old version first so the game does not load the cached one. 🎛 Customize It Want less fog? Open the fogs folder inside the pack and find the fog file for the biome you want to change. Each file has a value called fog_start . Raise it (for example from 0.20 to 0.40) and the fog starts farther away, which gives you a clearer view. Lower it for thicker mist. If you want to change the sky or water color, edit the colors in biomes_client.json . ⚠ What This Pack Is Not To keep things honest, here is exactly what to expect. Arctic Horizon is a standard resource pack , not a shader. That means it does not add real-time shadows, water reflections, wind-animated leaves, bloom or true volumetric god rays that pass through trees. The sun rays are part of the sun texture, so they are visible when you look at the sun. Fog and sky colors also stay the same through the day and night cycle. If you want those effects, they need a shader or Vibrant Visuals, and this pack does not claim to replace them. What it does give you is a clean, light and consistent Arctic atmosphere that works for everyone. ❓ FAQ Is this a shader? No. It is a lightweight atmosphere resource pack. Does it need Vibrant Visuals? No. Keep Vibrant Visuals off. Will it lag my phone? It is very small and adds no heavy effects, so it should be gentle on most devices. Nothing changed after installing. What do I do? Check that the pack is active in Global Resources, move it to the top, remove any older copy and disable other packs that change fog or sky. Can I use it in a video or modpack? Yes, please credit BRGamers and link back to this page. 💙 Credits and Support Created by BRGamers . All assets are original. If you enjoy the pack, leave a rating, share a screenshot and tell your friends. Feedback helps the pack get better with every update. Stay cool. Stay misty. Enjoy the horizon. ☀

title: SERPENT VISUALS
description: SERPENT VISUALS brings a vivid, glowing Vibrant Visuals atmosphere to Minecraft Bedrock — cozy campfire-lit nights, golden sunsets, lush vivid lakes, misty rain, a fiery nether, and glowing gold-lit caves.
compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: SERPENT VISUALS is an original Vibrant Visuals atmosphere pack for Minecraft Bedrock Edition, built to turn ordinary daylight and night cycles into something vivid, warm and glowing. It doesn't touch any block models or vanilla textures — it rewrites how light, sky, fog and color behave, using Minecraft's own Vibrant Visuals (deferred lighting) system. COZY, WARM NIGHTS Villages at night feel inviting rather than flat. Campfires, torches and lanterns glow a richer warm orange, casting a visible pool of light on the grass and nearby walls. The night sky is a deep, soft navy rather than plain black, with gentle drifting clouds and a calm, moody atmosphere perfect for a quiet evening around a fire. VIVID LAKES AND FORESTS Daytime water is clean, saturated and blue, with soft reflections of the sky and trees. Forest greens are rich and alive rather than dull, so a lakeside view full of trees feels lush and vibrant under a bright, clear sky. GOLDEN, CINEMATIC SUNSETS Sunrise and sunset get real presence: a bigger, brighter glowing sun sits low on the horizon, with the sky sweeping from warm gold near the sun into soft lavender and dusky blue higher up. Treelines turn into dramatic silhouettes against the glow, and a light haze near the ground adds depth to the scene. SOFT, OVERCAST RAIN Rainy weather shifts the whole mood — flatter, cooler grey-green light, a denser low haze, and muted colors that feel properly overcast, so wet village streets and rainy days actually look and feel different from a clear day. A FIERY NETHER The Nether leans harder into its heat: a deeper red-orange haze, brighter glowing lava, and warmer embers from fire and magma blocks, so lava oceans and basalt cliffs feel properly dangerous and alive. GLOWING GOLDEN CAVES Lush Caves and Dripstone Caves carry their own warm gold-amber glow, so hanging vines and glow lichen light up the stone around them instead of sitting in flat grey light — caves feel like a place worth exploring, not just a hole in the ground. RICHER COLOR GRADING THROUGHOUT On top of every scene above, SERPENT VISUALS applies its own color grading — boosted saturation across highlights, midtones and shadows, a touch more contrast, and a slightly raised exposure — so colors stay vivid and alive everywhere, without tipping into neon or unnatural territory. WHAT THIS PACK DOES NOT DO To keep expectations honest: SERPENT VISUALS works entirely through Minecraft's documented Vibrant Visuals resource-pack system — sky, fog, lighting, color grading and water. It cannot add camera depth-of-field blur, bloom halos beyond normal emissive glow, film grain, or any cinematic camera effect, and it cannot change tree types or block placement. Those need a different kind of mod entirely. What changes here is color, light and atmosphere. REQUIREMENTS Minimum engine version 1.21.100. title: CELEB VISUALS
description: Celeb VISUALS is a biome-aware Vibrant Visuals shader. Jungles glow in teal haze with yellow-green sunrises, oceans sink into deep blue fog, nights turn teal and starry, and every biome gets its own light colour.

fullDescription: Celeb VISUALS is a Vibrant Visuals shader for Minecraft Bedrock built around one idea: every biome should have its own light. Instead of giving the whole world one colour mood, it tints the sun, sky, ambient light, fog and water separately for each biome. Jungles get a blue-cyan daytime sky, teal-green haze that settles between the trees and teal water. At sunrise and sunset the horizon turns yellow-green, so the sun looks like it is shining through a humid canopy. Shadows lean teal instead of plain grey. Oceans and rivers sit under a deep blue sky and a dense blue fog that begins close to the player, so far shores dissolve into mist. The water surface is a deeper blue. Warm sunsets stay orange over the sea. Nights are teal. The sky shifts to deep navy at the top and teal towards the horizon, and the colour changes by biome: teal in default biomes and jungles, plum in cherry groves, icy blue in snowy biomes and ghostly violet in the pale garden. Rain keeps a soft grey fog, so wet days feel flat and muted instead of colourful. Cherry groves use rose-pink light and sky. The Nether burns ember red-orange. The End stays violet-magenta. Snowy biomes are icy blue, swamps murky olive, mushroom islands violet-pink, deserts and savannas amber, lush caves emerald and the deep dark eerie teal. Across all 88 biomes the pack uses 13 colour groups, and every biome points to its own light, sky and fog settings. Water is tinted to match each palette. Colour grading is richer than vanilla, with boosted saturation and ACES filmic tone mapping. Shadow maps are doubled in resolution so edges stay crisp. Compatibility. The pack contains no textures, so it works with any texture pack. It targets Minecraft Bedrock 1.21.100 or newer and uses only settings formats from 1.21.90 and below. Setup. Turn on Vibrant Visuals in Video settings. Place the pack at the top of your resource pack list. Do not stack it with other shaders. Remove older versions before importing. Limits. Aurora lights, shooting stars and glass-like clouds are not part of this pack, because Bedrock resource packs cannot create them. Creator & Credits
