fullDescription: Clearstone 128x – Faithful Style Clearstone Forged 128x is a high-resolution texture pack for Minecraft Bedrock Edition that keeps the familiar Minecraft appearance while adding sharper details and a refined medieval forged style. Blocks, items, materials, buildings and landscapes have been enhanced with detailed 128x textures. The pack supports both normal Bedrock graphics and Vibrant Visuals in one package. ✦ Main Features High-resolution 128x textures Faithful-style Minecraft appearance Classic Bedrock graphics support Vibrant Visuals support PBR materials Normal maps for selected textures Enhanced stone, wood and metal surfaces Improved tools and item textures Detailed building materials Enhanced villages and medieval structures Improved terrain and landscapes Selected emissive light sources Multiplayer support Bedrock Dedicated Server support One complete hybrid resource pack Classic Graphics & Vibrant Visuals Clearstone Forged 128x combines support for both Minecraft graphics modes in one resource pack. With normal Bedrock graphics enabled, the regular high-resolution textures remain available. On supported devices using Vibrant Visuals, selected materials can additionally use: Surface depth Normal maps Metallic properties Roughness differences Enhanced material definition Improved lighting response Selected emissive textures Vibrant Visuals is optional and is not required to use the normal 128x textures. Installation on Minecraft Bedrock Download the .mcpack file. Open the downloaded file with Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Wait until Minecraft confirms that the resource pack was imported successfully. Open the settings of your world. Select Resource Packs . Open My Packs . Find Faithful Style Bedrock Clearstone Forged 128x – Texture Pack . Select the pack and press Activate . Start or restart the world. If your device supports Vibrant Visuals, it can additionally be enabled in the Minecraft video settings. Updating the Texture Pack The internal pack version is: 2.0.0 The pack uses the same internal UUID when updating this 128x edition. A newer release can therefore replace an older version without requiring a new world. If Minecraft continues to display older textures, remove the previous cached version from the Minecraft storage settings and import the latest .mcpack file again. Bedrock Dedicated Server Installation 1. Rename the File Rename the downloaded file extension: Faithful-Style-Bedrock-Clearstone-Forged-128x-Texture-Pack.mcpack to: Faithful-Style-Bedrock-Clearstone-Forged-128x-Texture-Pack.zip Extract the ZIP archive. 2. Copy the Resource Pack Copy the extracted resource-pack folder into the following server directory: resource_packs/ Example: resource_packs/Clearstone-Forged-128x/ The folder must directly contain: manifest.json pack_icon.png textures LICENSE.txt Do not place another .mcpack or ZIP file inside the resource-pack folder. 3. Assign the Pack to Your World Open your server world directory: worlds/YOUR_WORLD_NAME/ Create or edit: world_resource_packs.json Add the following entry: [ { "pack_id": "c192b227-9f82-4867-b116-881fc7395734", "version": [2, 0, 0] } ] The UUID comes from the header.uuid section of the included manifest.json . Do not use the module UUID. 4. Servers with Existing Resource Packs If world_resource_packs.json already contains other resource packs, do not remove them. Add Clearstone Forged 128x as another entry: [ { "pack_id": "EXISTING-RESOURCE-PACK-UUID", "version": [1, 0, 0] }, { "pack_id": "c192b227-9f82-4867-b116-881fc7395734", "version": [2, 0, 0] } ] Remember to place a comma between the entries. 5. Require the Texture Pack To require connected players to download the server resource pack, open: server.properties Set: texturepack-required=true Use false instead if players should be allowed to join without accepting the resource pack. 6. Restart the Server Completely stop and restart the Bedrock Dedicated Server. During startup, check the server log and confirm that the resource pack was loaded successfully. If the log reports that the configured pack could not be found, check that: The pack is inside resource_packs The folder directly contains manifest.json The UUID matches header.uuid The version is [2, 0, 0] world_resource_packs.json is located inside the correct world folder The correct world is selected through level-name in server.properties Updating a Dedicated Server When installing a newer version: Stop the server. Replace the existing resource-pack folder. Open the new manifest.json . Check the new header.version . Update the version inside world_resource_packs.json if it has changed. Restart the server. Players may need to reconnect so Minecraft can download the updated resource pack. Compatibility Minecraft Bedrock Edition Windows Android iOS Consoles where external resource packs are supported Singleplayer Multiplayer Bedrock Dedicated Server Classic Graphics Vibrant Visuals on supported devices Performance depends on the device. Because this is a 128x texture pack, it requires more memory and graphics performance than a normal 16x or 64x resource pack.

fullDescription: This is NOT an RTX pack. RTX Visuals is a Minecraft Bedrock Vibrant Visuals resource pack. It uses Vibrant Visuals features to create RTX-inspired lighting and visuals. RTX Visuals is a project I’ve been working on to make Minecraft feel more alive without completely changing the vanilla style. 72 animated texture sets with 2,600+ animation frames, covering leaves, flowers, grass, vines, crops, bushes, bamboo, saplings, and other vegetation. The main thing I wanted was for the plants to actually feel like they’re moving in the wind instead of just jumping between a few frames. I’ve spent a lot of time experimenting with the animation frames and trying to make the pixels move together with the plant. RTX-inspired lighting Light sources such as torches, lanterns, soul torches, and other glowing blocks have enhanced lighting and Vibrant Visuals support. Soul lights keep their blue/cyan atmosphere, while other light sources keep their own colors. Calm water Water has subtle movement while avoiding distracting bright white spots. The goal is a cleaner, calmer water surface that still feels alive. Vibrant Visuals + volumetric effects The pack takes advantage of Minecraft Bedrock’s Vibrant Visuals features to push the lighting and atmosphere further while keeping the overall look of the pack intact. Credits & Inspiration A huge thank you to Vanilla RTX and the Poppy’s Luminous Dreams shader team . Their projects were a huge inspiration for me, and studying their work and coding helped me learn a lot about how visual effects can be created. Also, a huge thank you to VottexLab and their Better Waving Leaves project on CurseForge for allowing me to use their plant assets as a starting point for creating my own moving-leaf animations. This project wouldn’t have been possible without the inspiration and work from these creators. Please check out and support their original projects! RTX Visuals V2.3.0 — Update Log New in V2.3.0 Added PBR support for improved material detail and surface depth. Improved lighting for a more realistic and cinematic look. Added and improved cinematic fog effects. Improved water visuals and reflections. Enhanced shadows and ambient lighting. Improved particles and visual effects. Updated visual assets for better consistency across the pack. Improved overall color, atmosphere, and environment quality. Optimized visual settings for a smoother experience where possible. Updated the pack name and version to RTX Visuals V2.3.0. Overall RTX Visuals V2.3.0 focuses on making Minecraft Bedrock look more realistic and cinematic through improved PBR materials, lighting, fog, water, shadows, and environmental effects.

fullDescription: ✨ Invisible Buttons – Minecraft Bedrock Addon 📖 About This Addon Invisible Buttons is a Minecraft Bedrock addon designed to give players a cleaner, more minimalistic touch-control interface without removing the functionality of the buttons. This addon makes all on-screen touch-control buttons invisible while keeping them fully functional. This means players can still interact with Minecraft normally, even though the buttons are no longer visible on the screen. The goal is to provide a less cluttered screen, allowing players to enjoy their Minecraft worlds with a cleaner visual experience. 🎮 Features Invisible Touch Controls: All touch-control buttons become invisible, giving the screen a cleaner appearance. Fully Functional Buttons: Even though the buttons cannot be seen, they can still be tapped and used normally. Copy Button Remains Visible: The Copy button is intentionally kept visible and is not affected by the addon. Cleaner Gameplay: Removing visible buttons reduces interface clutter and gives players more unobstructed screen space. Mobile-Friendly Experience: Designed for Minecraft Bedrock players who use touchscreen controls on mobile devices and tablets. 🌟 How Does It Change Minecraft? Normally, Minecraft Bedrock displays several touch-control buttons on the screen while playing. These buttons can cover parts of the game world and sometimes make the interface look crowded. With Invisible Buttons enabled, the touch controls become transparent while retaining their functionality. title: Thumbnail: Glowing Outline
description: Every pixel of every block, item and mob gets its own thin, glowing white-yellow outline, while the block colours stay clear and true. Outlines fade with distance. 256x resource pack for Minecraft
compatibility: Bedrock向け（配布元でバージョン確認）
fullDescription: Baku_Studio 24 Nov 2026 Textures Copy link Glowing Outline Go to files Glowing Outline Texture Pack gives Minecraft Bedrock Edition a completely new look. Every single pixel of every block, item and mob is framed by its own thin, glowing outline in warm white with just a hint of yellow. The result is a crisp, luminous pixel grid that feels handcrafted, futuristic and instantly recognisable. WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT Many outline packs only trace the edges of large shapes. Glowing Outline goes much further: each pixel becomes a tiny cell with its own hairline border. The line is brightest along the top and left edge of the cell and softer along the bottom and right, while a gentle glow bleeds inward. Surfaces look lit from within, giving depth and sparkle without ever hiding what the block really is. COLOURS STAY TRUE The number one design rule was simple: you must always know what you are looking at. The inside of every cell keeps its original colour, so stone is still stone, grass is still green and diamond ore still shows its cyan gems. The outline never floods or tints the texture. Dark blocks such as obsidian stay dark, with their pixels neatly traced in light. OUTLINES THAT FADE WITH DISTANCE Up close you get the full detailed look, with every pixel traced and softly glowing. As you move away, the outlines thin out and blend into the block colour, so far terrain, mountains and forests look clean and natural. This keeps the horizon free of visual noise and lets the glow shine exactly where you are looking. EVERYTHING IS COVERED More than 3,300 textures are included: over 1,400 blocks, around 980 items, plus mobs, armor and other entities. Cut-out blocks such as leaves, glass, flowers and saplings keep their original shapes, and only their solid pixels are outlined, so transparency still looks right. Light sources such as glowstone, lanterns and lava keep their brightness. Effect textures like the sky, clouds, particles, enchantment glint, armor trims and biome colour maps are deliberately left untouched, so nothing breaks or looks strange. A CLOSER LOOK Walk through a forest and every grass block becomes a tidy, glowing mosaic. Ores sparkle as their coloured pixels are picked out by fine lines of light. Planks, bricks and stone bricks show off every pixel of their pattern. In your inventory, tools, armor and food keep their familiar colours while gaining a clean glowing pixel border, so every item is easy to read at a glance. Mobs get the same treatment with a slightly finer grid and stay easy to recognise. Whether you are building a cosy village or a huge redstone base, the outlines help you see block edges, shapes and patterns more clearly. BUILT FOR BEDROCK AND MOBILE This is a pure resource pack. It needs no add-ons, no scripts, no experimental toggles and no shaders. Import the .mcpack file, activate it in Global Resources or in your world settings, and play. The pack uses 256x textures for razor-sharp lines, yet the download is only about 23 MB. If you notice lag on an older device, lowering your render distance will help. WORKS WITH SHADERS Because the glow is baked directly into the textures, the pack looks great on its own. It also pairs well with shader packs, which can add extra lighting on top of the outlines. PERFECT FOR Survival worlds, creative builds, adventure maps, screenshots, showcase videos and anyone who wants a world that stands out with a unique, eye-catching pixel-grid style you will notice from the very first second. Thank you for downloading Glowing Outline Texture Pack. Enjoy exploring your world in a whole new light. Pack Details Author / Creator: Baku_Studio Version: 1.0.0 Type: Resource pack (textures only, no add-ons or scripts) Resolution: 256x Platform: Minecraft Bedrock Edition (Pocket Edition), minimum engine version 1.18.0 File size: about 23 MB (.mcpack) Textures: 3,320 (blocks, items, mobs, armor, some paintings) Key Features Thin glowing white-yellow outline on every pixel Brighter top/left edges, softer bottom/right edges, soft inner glow True block and item colours stay clearly visible Outlines fade with distance, so far terrain stays clean Transparent blocks keep their shape (only solid pixels are outlined) Light sources keep their brightness Sky, clouds, particles, enchant glint and biome colours left untouched for stability Works alone or with shader packs How to Install Download the .mcpack file. Open it with Minecraft (tap the file and choose Minecraft). Wait for the "Import successful" message. Go to Settings → Storage/Global Resources and activate Glowing Outline Texture Pack. Or open your world's settings, choose Resource Packs, and activate it there. Turn off other texture packs, or move this one to the top of the list. Enter your world and enjoy. fullDescription: Youseef-Tools 6 Oct 2026 Textures Copy link Clear And Borderless Glass Go to files Clear & Borderless Glass for Minecraft Bedrock 1.26 — three tiny packs that fix ugly glassGlass is one of the best building blocks in Minecraft — right up until you actually look through it. In vanilla Bedrock every glass block carries a thick, opaque frame, so a wall of glass ends up looking like a spreadsheet instead of a window. Clear & Borderless Glass is a set of three standalone resource packs that remove that frame, keep the transparency, and let your builds finally look the way you imagined them.No subpacks, no settings, no behaviour pack, no experimental toggles. You pick one file, you tap it, and your glass changes.The problem with vanilla glassOpen any modern house build and look through the windows. What you see is not the view — it is a grid of white borders stacked on top of the view. Two things make it worse: The frame is per block, not per pane. A 6×4 window is 24 blocks, so you get 24 frames instead of one window frame. The frame is fully opaque, so it survives any lighting, any shader and any angle. That is fine when glass is decoration. It is painful when the glass is the point of the build: aquariums, greenhouses, sky bridges, ocean monuments, modern villas, observation decks, mob farms with glass walls.The three variants Pack File Look Best for Borderless Glass release/borderless-glass.mcpack The frame is gone; only four small corner dots remain Big window walls, aquariums, greenhouses Clear Glass release/clear-glass.mcpack Fully transparent centre with a thin, visible frame Builds where glass must still read as glass Clear & Borderless Glass release/clear-borderless-glass.mcpack Transparent centre and no frame at all The cleanest look — glass that disappears All three cover the same 35 textures, so nothing is missing when you switch: plain glass tinted_glass all 16 stained glass colours the matching 16 glass_pane_top textures (the pane face) Because the packs are three separate files with three different UUIDs, you can install all of them at the same time and activate a different one per world without any conflict.How to install Download the .mcpack you want. Open the file — Minecraft Bedrock launches and imports the pack automatically. Open your world → Settings → Resource Packs → activate the pack. Done. There is no subpack menu and nothing else to configure.
